title: AI Product Engineering & UX
summary: Turn model capability into a product people can use and trust: problem discovery, uncertainty-aware UX, architecture decisions, experiments, adoption, and lifecycle ownership.
outcomes: Frame an AI product around a user decision and measurable outcome rather than a model feature
Design interfaces for uncertainty, evidence, correction, approval, and accessible fallback
Make build/buy and system-architecture decisions with explicit quality, risk, cost, and exit criteria
Run pilots and experiments that measure adoption, task outcomes, and unintended effects

lessons.title: AI UX, uncertainty, and human control
